units.title: Amazing places in Egypt

reading.title: A day in Egypt
reading.text: People can enjoy many activities in one day in Egypt. In the morning, tourists visit ancient sites like the pyramids. Then, they walk to a small museum to learn more about history. After that, they go to Khan El Khalili to buy souvenirs such as handmade gifts. Some people like to take photos in beautiful places. At night, people can relax and listen to music. Egypt is a great place to visit and have fun.

lessons.title: Lesson 3 The Wonderful Nile River

reading.text: I'm Omar. Last week, I went to the museum with my family. There were lots of things to see at it. We visited a room with lots of jewelry. There were bracelets, necklaces and rings from Ancient Egypt. After the jewelry, we saw tools and artifacts. The museum was amazing. I like history. We went back home at twelve o’clock.

lessons.title: Lesson 4&5 Unforgettable Trip to Wadi El Rayan

reading.text: We all live in a community and we should all help the people who live in it. When you help as a volunteer, it’s a great way to help your community. You can learn new skills, make new friends, and make your neighborhood a better place. We spoke to people in our neighborhood about different ways people can make our community stronger. We can pick up garbage with cousins. Garbage is really annoying. We can use gloves, bags and special sticks to pick up the garbage. The park is a good place to play, so we should keep it clean.

questions.verifiedAnswer: You can learn new skills, make new friends, and make your neighborhood a better place.

questions.question: What can people do to keep the park clean?

lessons.note: The printed heading names Wadi El Rayan, while the passage is about volunteering and keeping a park clean. Preserved as printed and flagged.
